hardware.title: This computer
hardware.recommend: Recommended models for this computer: speech {{whisper}}, translation {{gemma}}.
hardware.slow: From its hardware, this computer may not run the local models in real time. Run the benchmark to measure it, or use Gemini with a Google API key.
hardware.slowMeasured: The benchmark says the local models don’t keep up in real time here. Use smaller models, or use Gemini with a Google API key.
hardware.localMissing: Not running: {{names}}. The local provider and the benchmark need both. Start them (see docs/dev.md), then check again.
hardware.benchmarkHelp: The benchmark runs the local models on a bundled clip of about 40 seconds. It needs whisper-server and Ollama running, and can take a few minutes.
hardware.verdictOk: The local models keep up on this computer: local sessions can run with them.
hardware.verdictSlow: The local models fall behind on this computer. Pick smaller models below, or use Gemini for live sessions.

models.title: Local models
models.intro: The speech and translation models the local provider runs. Download them here, then choose which ones new sessions use.
models.current: New local sessions use speech {{whisper}} and translation {{gemma}}.
models.none: The server offers no local models to download.
models.savedWhisper: New local sessions will use {{name}}. whisper-server loads its model at launch: restart it with ggml-{{name}}.bin so it runs the same one.
models.savedGemma: New local sessions will translate with {{name}}.
models.settingsUnavailable: The settings couldn’t be read, so the models new sessions use can’t be changed here.
models.whisperDown: whisper-server isn’t answering at {{url}}. The speech models still download here, but whisper-server has to be started with one (--model <models dir>/ggml-<name>.bin) before local sessions work.
models.ollamaDown: Ollama isn’t answering at {{url}}, and the Gemma translation models download through it.
models.startSidecars: Start them (see docs/dev.md) and check again.
models.background: Downloads continue on the server if you leave this page. A stopped download resumes where it left off.
